name: autogoal
title: 目标达成者
description:
Autonomous goal achievement skill.

Use when the user says something like:
 - 'I want to make profit in the #kalshi channel'
 - 'Keep my homelab uptime above 99.9%'
 - 'Improve my trading win rate'
 - 'Make this project successful'
 - 'Achieve this goal'
 - 'I need a system to work toward X'
 - Any open-ended long-term objective the user wants automated progress on

 This skill wires up a goal with periodic check-ins, automatic strategy adaptation, and progress reporting. It is NOT for one-off tasks — use it when the user wants ongoing, self-improving pursuit of a goal.

Trigger examples:
 - User: 'make this channel profitable'
 - User: 'set up the goal system to maximize X'
 - User: 'give openclaw a goal and it automatically does what it can to achieve that goal'
